result.markdown:
For most startups, I'd recommend **Linear** if you're building a tech product, or **Notion** if you want one flexible workspace for managing the entire business.

The best choice depends on your team's size, working style, and whether you need to manage product development, marketing, operations, or everything together.

Here are my top recommendations.

## Top 6 project management tools for startups

![Finastra Customer Story | ClickUp™](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/OXxUksa73j7hoTxbYQ6zo3pspX36GflPBLMsRWXjhfWZTJdFq6md_tXaxCCc_3Kjh0xQSrUSgXoCYi3d5TOe48r-mvzFwLplQbgf4lhsH3q_bsATt_hAcyva5qI1DtZG8OasgRxxldReZAIfURcJdNdt2Br8nPVvqn-lCO5aR2MxpFl9QAiCxibf4gzehOOb?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. ClickUp**

(Best overall)

- Tasks, projects, goals, docs and dashboards.
- Highly customisable.
- Good value for smaller teams.
- Downside: can feel overwhelming.

Best for: startups wanting one system for everything.

[Explore ClickUp](https://clickup.com/)

---

![Productivity Stack 2025: The Tools I Actually Use Daily | BlazeRift Project](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/4-TFr-ckQa-9bk8x5VN6sHjvab4UlZlJSmaxKNZqzorDbJHhW9DZ8v93iaVDfIkiOzoQ9x20fGWVh1jqG14cmFmuMUJrmAEpojnY6HPNQuTrQU9N60U1XJ7CBUVFqcXv7Vql7t3Kw83XWIte6ogtmJCGxWNK9WER_Kx53zTD3Ok1fUBOX0LQAPsxApxNVahh?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Linear**

(Best for tech startups)

- Excellent product roadmaps.
- Sprint and issue tracking.
- Clean, fast interface.
- Great developer workflows.

Best for: SaaS, AI and software companies.

[Explore Linear](https://linear.app/)

---

![Project Management Hub Template by Gridvio | Notion Marketplace](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/6e1oG6Y_aW5V5yDl222hE8Y8t-T__05L0OPLqrtY2b6KrmvS_M-QH4eaVLv4afPJUAGCFGr_eoifL-Irt3_HiUqUmKW08dRjhIxW2MfVWL_nPAWNaujkMp5zdq2VbJkW7b3h6jvrTVNAFmmVU9MPLCBztqWrhslDc_LeRhpbcV451et11onvlpgBLkBnIYcR?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Notion**

- Project tracking and documentation.
- Company wiki and meeting notes.
- Flexible databases and templates.
- Easy to adapt as you grow.

Best for: early-stage founders managing multiple areas of the business.

[Explore Notion](https://www.notion.com/)

---

![New: Asana’s Milestones help you visualize project progress • Asana](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/045PY8MNTZCNbuEY_9zoc2ZmyVm82bEUQrACKq4DMJ2rZRzBOKtwnHDDeSB865DF__R-b4CGI6GEhHdu4YJMzkB1qcjJuCRLXmMhkxG9zfIfGx-0L1EgDFt_aMUwOdh5HR45ijTcFpeq8HRM8juB5v_Vffpp7OzTfiaEKInBCXkUCm5590f5v87DKC8sKsga?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Asana**

- Clear task ownership.
- Project timelines and dependencies.
- Good cross-team visibility.

Best for: teams coordinating marketing, sales, operations and product.

[Explore Asana](https://asana.com/)

---

![What's New - monday.com Product Updates](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/A6uqDbwZDZtLi6fdSQ4vBgCQbnekV0PIx4KVuVyvOr829LpE2bCzHdwMLqPfPl8gWESkzkwLYt7S32LGreo4ooKI7LMbOa3LDgEJY5XamBVn4I4fKACcjxheDQNjN3kYBWjEyVTME7rTaH0lrtDPHD2D7YT1KNXf7LC0zf16zSR-GU4N3mIXikR458xkW8a1?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. monday.com**

- Visual project dashboards.
- Workflow automation.
- Customisable business processes.

Best for: growing startups with multiple departments.

[Explore monday.com](https://monday.com/)

---

![How to Toggle Trello Views: Calendar, Table, Timeline & More](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Md351UxojPqr7NcZARTUVuAl7ocTctX4xXxse2slXCoIC1a14ed7C82Suo3_BLOf8uMvPvkR6a7txy4RworeyrfELrkzyRnZeSU5JT9wx8ysI4A-zP3PbB-iwMrUJ8znrFR0rgAWlJ-HP1EFK6mtsJMgFbfykp-Rc-ETfrBKJfKEo5IF5n0UcFY7ie8JejkV?purpose=fullsize)

**6\. Trello**

- Simple Kanban boards.
- Easy task assignment.
- Very quick to learn.

Best for: tiny teams and bootstrapped startups.

[Explore Trello](https://trello.com/)

## My recommendation

I'd shortlist these three\:

| Startup situation | My choice |
|--------|--------|
| General startup, one platform | ClickUp |
| Software / AI startup | Linear |
| Early-stage, managing the whole business | Notion |


One important tip: don't overcomplicate things. Start with a task board, clear owners, deadlines and weekly priorities. You don't need enterprise project management when you have five people.
